name: Coggeshall: Kidder compression
blurb: Kidder’s isentropic compression, Coggeshall’s problem 6 (ExactPack’s cog6, gamma = 5/3): gas starting at rest and falling inward as u = -r t / (tau^2 - t^2), squeezed without a shock so that all of it would reach the center at t = tau = 1.25. By t = 1 every element is at 0.6 of its starting radius, on shells from r = 0.1 to 1. Both radial faces are held at the exact solution.
